extracted.intended_audience: meeting planners and event managers (corporate, college, and association event organizers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for event planners on selecting, requesting, and securing keynote or motivational speakers through a speaker bureau, including timeline, required inquiry details, evaluation criteria, and cost considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Easy speaker booking process (5 steps)
rubrics_metrics.description: Book a keynote speaker through CAA Speakers in 5 simple steps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact CAA Speakers at speakers@caa.com or fill out the contact form; review speaker recommendations based on your criteria; select your preferred speaker from curated options; sign contract while CAA handles negotiations; relax while we coordinate travel, logistics, and event details.

rubrics_metrics.name: What to include in your inquiry
rubrics_metrics.description: Required information to provide when requesting speaker options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include event date, location, and audience size; budget range and speaking topics; any specific speaker preferences or requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended lead time for booking
rubrics_metrics.description: How far in advance to contact the bureau for best speaker availability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact 1-3 months before your event for best speaker availability, though urgent requests can be accommodated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keynote speaker cost considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Factors that determine speaker fees and additional costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Costs vary depending on the speaker's expertise, demand, and event requirements. Additional costs may include travel and accommodation expenses, audio/visual and technical requirements, and fees for workshops, meet-and-greets, or book signings. Contact CAA for customized pricing based on your event budget and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the desired speaker isn't listed
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and expectation when you don't see a specific speaker on the public roster.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CAA has access to thousands of speakers beyond the website roster; booking agents maintain relationships across industries and can secure speakers not publicly listed. Provide details about expertise area, speaking style, and budget for custom matching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why choose a reputable bureau (selection criteria for agency)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advantages event planners should expect from a top-tier speaker bureau.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for direct relationships with A-list speakers, priority access to speakers unavailable elsewhere, industry expertise, full-service support from booking to event execution, and global reach with local expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: CAA quality assurance and service standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Services and safeguards the bureau provides to ensure a successful speaker engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect rigorous speaker vetting and professional coaching, dedicated booking agents for personalized service, comprehensive logistics coordination, reliable backup plans and contingency support, and a proven track record with Fortune 500 companies and major events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define event objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Start your speaker selection by clarifying the event's goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine key messages and desired outcomes to guide speaker topic and tone selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Know your audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Match the speaker to the demographics and interests of attendees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider industry, demographics, and interests when evaluating speaker fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider speaker qualities
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate individual speaker attributes that affect impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess speaker expertise, presentation style, and credibility when selecting a candidate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate practical factors
rubrics_metrics.description: Logistics and constraints that influence speaker choice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider budget, availability, and technical needs when choosing a speaker.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review speaker materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Use available content to judge a speaker's suitability and performance style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review videos, testimonials, and topic outlines to evaluate fit and quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speaker categories and topic matching
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of speakers and topics a bureau can provide to meet event needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CAA represents business leaders, entertainment personalities, authors and thought leaders, and specialized experts. Speaking topics include leadership, innovation, sales/marketing, workplace culture, mental health/wellness, entrepreneurship, and business growth — pick categories aligned with your event goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: How the bureau helps find your ideal speaker
rubrics_metrics.description: Services the bureau provides to discover and recommend appropriate speakers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CAA provides access to an extensive speaker network beyond the roster, leverages relationships for custom speaker matching, and offers budget-friendly alternatives and recommendations based on your requirements.
